title: Asian Style Braised Short Ribs
text: Asian Style Braised Short Ribs Asian Style Braised Short Ribs Recipe courtesy of Emeril Lagasse Total Time: 3 hr 30 min | Prep: 15 min | Cook: 3 hr 15 min | Yield: 4 servings | Level: Easy Ingredients: Delete All 5 pounds beef short ribs, cut into 4-ounce portions 1 cup soy sauce 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar 3 cloves garlic, peeled and smashed 1 (5-inch) stalk lemongrass, halved and smashed 1 tablespoon peeled and minced ginger 1/2 cup light brown sugar 1 quart water 1/2 cup sliced green onion bottoms, white part only 3/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper 1/4 cup fresh orange juice 1/4 cup hoisin sauce 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice Jasmine Rice, for serving 2 teaspoons finely grated orange rind, for serving Sliced green onion tops, optional for garnish Directions: Delete All - Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. - In a wide stockpot or Dutch oven, combine the short ribs, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, lemongrass, ginger, brown sugar, water, green onion bottoms, crushed red pepper, and 2 tablespoons of the orange juice. Ensure the short ribs are submerged in the liquid. - Bake the short ribs, covered, for about 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bones. Remove the short ribs from the braising liquid and cover to keep warm. Increase the oven temperature to 425 degrees F. - Drain the fat off of the cooking liquid and discard. Place the remaining braising juices in a medium saucepan with 1/4 cup of the hoisin sauce and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce the liquid until only about 1 1/4 cups remain. Strain through a fine-meshed strainer, discarding the solids. Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of orange juice and the lemon juice. - Return the short ribs and the reduced sauce to the stockpot or Dutch oven, coating the short ribs well with the sauce. Bake for 10 minutes, until the short ribs are heated through and slightly glazed. Serve hot over jasmine rice. Season each portion with the orange zest and garnish with the green onions if desired.

title: Baked Salmon with Mushroom Cream Sauce
text: Baked Salmon with Mushroom Cream Sauce Baked Salmon with Mushroom Cream Sauce Serves 4 Pairs well with Roasted Potato-Carrot | Broccoli-Onions Ingredients Delete All 1 1/2 lbs fresh salmon, skin on or off 2 tbsp unsalted butter 2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms (cremini, button, or shiitake) 2 green onions, chopped 2 tbsp all-purpose flour 2 tsp chopped fresh parsley 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 cup milk (whole or 2%) 1/4 cup dry white wine (or 2 tbsp water + 2 tbsp lemon juice) Instructions Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Cut salmon into 4 equal portions and pat dry. Lightly butter a 13×9-inch baking dish and arrange salmon evenly. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and green onions; sauté 5–7 minutes until tender. Stir in flour, parsley, and salt; cook 1 minute to form a roux. Gradually whisk in milk; bring to a boil. Cook and stir until thickened, about 2–3 minutes. Stir in wine (or water and lemon juice) and simmer 1 minute. Pour mushroom sauce evenly over the salmon. Bake uncovered 20–25 minutes, until salmon flakes easily.

title: Baked Tandoori Spiced Cauliflower
text: Baked Tandoori Spiced Cauliflower Baked Tandoori Spiced Cauliflower Ingredients Delete All 2 Garlic Cloves, Peeled 1/4 inch Piece Fresh Ginger, Peeled 1 TBS Tandoori Masala Spice Mix 1 tablespoon ground cumin 1 ½ teaspoons ground coriander 1 ½ teaspoons ground cardamom 1 ½ teaspoons ground black pepper 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ½ teaspoon ground cloves ½ teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 tsp Cayenne Pepper (optional) Juice of 1/2 Lemon 1/2 Cup Plain Yogurt Salt 1 Medium Cauliflower, leaves removed and base trimmed flat Olive Oil Dried chili flakes, to serve (optional) Instructions Delete All Using a fine grater, grate the garlic and ginger into a large mixing bowl. Add the spices and lemon juice and mix into a paste. Add the yogurt and stir, season well with salt. *** Try boiling the cauliflower for 20 + min. before following the rest of the recipe *** Place the cauliflower, base side up, in the bowel. Using clean hands, spread the yogurt marinade all over the cauliflower, then leave to marinate for at least 20 min., or up to 12 hours. When ready to cook, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Pat the Cauliflower, base side down, on a baking sheet rubbed with olive oil and pour over any extra marinade still in the bowl. Put the sheet into the oven and bake for 30 - 45 min, until golden and tender. Put the cauliflower on a serving plate, sprinkle with chili flakes if using, and slice it into wedges like a cake to serve. Image - add later --> Image - add later -->

title: Balsamic Roasted Beets
text: Balsamic Roasted Beets Balsamic Roasted Beets Ingredients Delete All 3 Beets, Peeled & Diced (about 3 Cups)* 1 TBS EVOO 1/2 tsp Salt 1 TBS Balsamic Vinegar 1 TBS Honey Instructions Delete All Preheat oven to 425 degrees Grease a large baking dish Toss beets with 1 TBS olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt, spread onto greased baking dish in an even layer. Bake for 15 - 20 min. Stir and bake for 10 min. more until beets are soft. Mix together balsamic and honey After 30 min. remove beets from the oven and add the honey/vinegar mixture to the baking dish. Stir until evenly coated. Return to the oven for 10 min., stirring once half way through. Roast until the balsamic/honey coats the beets. Remove from the oven and serve warm ** Instead of peeling and cutting the beets, you could roast them whole in the following manner: Wrap beets individually in foil and set on a baking sheet. Roast in an oven set to 450 degrees until beets are soft to the touch, 50 - 70 min. depending on the size of the beets. Remove the skin from the beets with your hands or paper towel. (at this point you can store the roasted beets until later when you're ready to add the rest of the ingredients, dice and roast) Dice and toss with recipe ingredients. Roast for 10 - 15 min. at 450 degrees until beets are soft and the balsamic mixture is thick and coats the beets. NOTES: The size of the beets are cut to make a difference in roasting time. Please be aware of this and check your beets after 15 min of cooking to ensure they are not getting overdone! Image - add later --> Image - add later -->

title: Balsamic-Glazed Onion Cheeseburgers - Blue Apron
text: Balsamic-Glazed Onion Cheeseburgers - Blue Apron Balsamic-Glazed Onion Cheeseburgers Makes: 2 Servings Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 30 - 40 min Ingredients: Delete All 10 oz Ground Beef (or 1 lb if cooking from home) 2 Potato Buns 2 Cloves Garlic 1 Yellow Onion 1 Russet Potato 2 oz Monterey Jack Cheese 2 Tbs Balsamic vinegar 1 tsp Whole Dried Rosemary Directions: Delete All Prepare The Ingredients: Preheat the oven to 475°F or light the grill. Wash and dry the produce, halve the buns. Cut potato into 1" wedges. Small dice the onion. Smash the garlic into a paste. Thinly slice the cheese. Roast the Potato Wedges: Olive oil, salt, and pepper the potatoes. Inside: place skin side down on sheet and roast 30 to 32 min. or until browned. Outside: start right before putting Jelayne's burger on for 4 min per side. Cook and Glaze the Onion: In a small pot, heat a drizzle of olive oil on medium-high heat. Add the onion, salt, and pepper. Cover, cook for 5 - 7 min, stirring occasionally. Add vinegar, cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 2 - 3 min, or until most of the liquid has cooked off. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper, set aside in a warm place. Form the Patties: In a medium bowl combine the ground beef, garlic paste, and as much of the rosemary as you want, season with salt and pepper. Gently mix to combine and form into (2 patties from Blue Apron OR 4 patties from home). Cook the Patties: Inside: Cook the patties in a pan and loosely cover with foil for 2 - 4 min. Flip, cover with cheese, cover with foil for another 2 - 4 min. Outside: Dude, you know what you are doing with a burger..... Toast the Buns and Plate the Dish: Toast the buns (in the pan if inside | on the grill if outside). Place the onions on the bottom bun. Then place the meat with the cheese. Then the top bun (optional).

title: Banana Sundaes
text: Banana Sundaes Home Recipes Contact Banana Sundaes Ingredients 3 Large firm bananas 1 Tbs margarine or butter, melted 2 tsp orange juice 1/2 cup caramel ice-cream topping 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon 1 pint vanilla ice cream 1/4 cup toasted coconut 1/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted Instructions Cut bananas in half lengthwise, then cut each piece in half crosswise. Stir together margarine or butter and 1 tsp of the orange juice. Brush mixture over all sides of banana pieces. Grill bananas over medium-hot heat for 4 minutes, turning halfway through grilling. Add bananas to the sauce and stir gently to coat. Spoon sauce and bananas over scoops of vanilla ice cream. Sprinkle with toasted coconut and almonds. text: Boiled Eggs Boiled Eggs Soft, Medium (Jammy), or Hard Boiled Ingredients Delete All Eggs Water Salt Vinegar Ice (for ice bath) Egg Doneness Chart Doneness Boil / Simmer Time* Yolk Texture Best Uses Soft Boiled 6 minutes Very runny, custard-like Ramen, toast soldiers Medium / Jammy 9–10 minutes Set whites, creamy center Salads, bowls, snacking Hard Boiled 12 minutes (off heat) Fully set Deviled eggs, egg salad *Timing starts once eggs are placed in boiling water or once simmering begins, depending on method. Instructions Hard Boiled Eggs Place eggs in pan with cold water, 1–2 inches above eggs. Add salt and vinegar. Slowly bring to a boil over high heat. When boiling starts, remove briefly and reduce heat. Return pan and simmer 1 minute. Cover and remove from heat for 12 minutes. Cool immediately in cold water or ice bath. title: Braised Beef Short Ribs
text: Braised Beef Short Ribs Braised Beef Short Ribs Ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs Bone-In English Style Cut Ribs 3 TBS Olive Oil 1 Cup Onions, Diced (about 1 medium) 4 Garlic Cloves, Minced 1/2 Cup Red Wine 2 Cups Beef Stock 2 TBS Tomato Paste 1/2 tsp Dried Thyme 12 oz Mushrooms, Cleaned and Quartered Parsley, Fresh Flat-Leaf, Chopped Instructions: - Remove ribs from the refrigerator to bring them to room temperature. - Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet. Sear the ribs on all sides until browned. Remove and set aside. - Add onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. - Add red wine and cook until reduced by half. - Place beef stock, tomato paste, and thyme into a slow cooker. - Add the reduced onion mixture to the slow cooker and nestle the ribs into the liquid. - Cook on low for 5 hours, then add the mushrooms. - Continue cooking for 1 more hour. - If desired, remove the liquid and reduce it in a skillet to make a sauce. - Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Bran Muffins
text: Bran Muffins Bran Muffins Ingredients: Delete All 1 ½ cups All-Bran cereal 1 cup buttermilk 1 egg 1 egg white 1/3 cup oil 2/3 cup light brown sugar, packed 1 cup grated carrots, grated on small/medium size holes 1 cup chopped walnuts, optional 1 cup raisins 1 Tablespoon vanilla extract 1 cup all-purpose flour 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda Instructions: Delete All 1. title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
text: Broccoli Cheese Soup Broccoli Cheese Soup Ingredients: 1/2 onion (large) 2 large carrots 2 stalks celery (medium) 2 cloves garlic 12 ounces broccoli florets (4 to 5 cups) 2 tablespoons salted butter 1/4 teaspoon salt (for vegetables) 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/4 cup all purpose flour 2 1/2 cups chicken broth (or vegetable broth) 2 cups whole milk 3/4 teaspoon salt (for soup) 1/2 teaspoon black pepper (for soup) 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese (use orange cheddar, 8 oz.) fresh parsley (minced, for serving) salt (optional, for serving) freshly ground black pepper (optional, for serving) Instructions: - Finely chop onion, carrots, and celery. Separately mince garlic, chop broccoli into 1/2-inch florets, and finely chop any broccoli stems. Set garlic and broccoli aside. - Melt butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, celery, and salt. Saute until vegetables are softened, 6 to 7 minutes. Add minced garlic and mustard to pot and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir to evenly coat. - Stream broth and milk into pot, stirring to dissolve flour. Season soup with salt and pepper, and then add broccoli. - Bring soup to a low boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring once or twice, until broccoli is just tender, about 10 minutes. - Turn off heat, but leave soup pot on the burner. Add half of the cheese to soup in 2 additions, stirring after each addition, until completely melted. - Mince parsley. Ladle soup into bowls and sprinkle with parsley. Add salt and freshly ground pepper to soup if you like.

title: Bruschetta with Tomato and Basil
text: Bruschetta with Tomato and Basil Bruschetta with Tomato and Basil Ingredients Delete All Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 20 minutes Yield: Makes 24 small slices. Serves 6-10 as an appetizer. 6 or 7 ripe plum tomatoes (about 1 1/2 lbs) 2 cloves garlic, minced (about 2 teaspoons) 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar 6-8 fresh basil leaves, thinly sliced* or chopped 1 teaspoon kosher salt, more or less to taste 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, more or less to taste 1 baguette French bread or similar Italian bread 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil *To thinly slice basil leaves, stack the leaves on top of each other and roll up like a cigar. Then make thin slices from one end of the basil cigar to the other. We suggest using plum tomatoes for bruschetta because they have thicker flesh with fewer seeds and less juice than regular tomatoes, but feel free to use any tomato for this recipe. If you use cherry tomatoes, just quarter them, don't bother blanching or peeling them. Instructions Delete All 1. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. As the water is heating make shallow cuts in a cross pattern at the tip ends of the tomatoes (this will make the tomatoes easier to peel). Once the water is boiling, remove the pot from the heat. Put the tomatoes in the hot water and blanch for 1 minute. Remove with a slotted spoon and let sit until cool enough to handle. Then gently peel off the tomato skins. Cut out the stem base with a paring knife. Cut the tomatoes into halves or quarters and squeeze out most of the juices and seeds. 2. Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) with a rack in the top slot of the oven. Finely chop the tomatoes and place them in a medium bowl. Mix in the minced garlic, 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil, and the balsamic vinegar. Stir in the thinly sliced basil and add salt and freshly ground black pepper, adding more to taste. Note, tomatoes love salt; you may need to add more than you expect. 3. Use a bread knife to slice the baguette on the diagonal making half-inch thick slices. Brush one side of each slice with olive oil (a pastry brush helps here) and place olive oil-side down on a baking sheet or roasting pan. The baguette slices will toast best in the top rack of your oven, so you may need to work in batches to toast them all. When the oven has reached 450°F (230°C) place the slices in the oven on the top rack and toast for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned around the edges. If you want you can toast the bread slices without coating them first in olive oil. Toast them until lightly browned on both sides. Then cut a clove of garlic in half and rub over one side of the toast. Then brush with olive oil. 4. Arrange the toasted bread on a platter, olive oil side facing up (the olive oil will help create a temporary barrier keeping the bread from getting soggy from the chopped tomatoes). title: Butter Cream Sauce
text: Butter Cream Sauce Butter Cream Sauce Ingredients: 0.5 cup white wine 0.5 garlic clove smashed 0.5 cup cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 2 tbsp cold butter salt and pepper to taste Instructions: Pour the white wine into a saucepan and add a smashed garlic clove. Set the pan over medium heat then bring to a simmer and allow the liquid to reduce by half, approximately 10 minutes. Whisk in the cream and allow to simmer, whisking regularly, until the cream has reduced and coats the back of a spoon easily. Stir in the lemon juice and cook, whisking regularly, for another 1-2 minutes. Take the pan off the heat then whisk in the cold butter, one cube at a time, until the butter is emulsified into the sauce. By adding the butter off of the heat, the butter won't melt quickly and cause the sauce to split. Taste and season with salt and pepper then serve.

title: Cajun Roast Turkey
text: Cajun Roast Turkey Cajun Roast Turkey Ingredients: Cajun Spice Mixture: Delete All 2 tablespoons garlic powder 2 tablespoons paprika 1 tablespoon dried oregano 1 tablespoon dried thyme 1 tablespoon freshly ground black pepper 1 tablespoon onion powder 4 teaspoons cayenne pepper Turkey and Gravy: 6 quarts cold water One 12-ounce bottle amber ale beer, room temperature 1 cup kosher salt 1 cup packed brown sugar 3 rosemary sprigs, divided One 14- to 16-pound whole turkey 3 celery stalks, coarsely chopped 2 green bell peppers, seeded, coarsely chopped 2 yellow onions, coarsely chopped 3/4 cup (1 1/2 sticks) unsalted butter, divided 4 cups homemade turkey stock or reduced-sodium chicken stock 3 thyme sprigs 1/4 cup all-purpose flour Preparation: Delete All To brine the turkey: In a large pot, bring 1 quart of water to a boil over high heat. Add the beer, salt, sugar, and 1/3 cup of the spice mixture and stir until the sugar has dissolved. Add 2 rosemary sprigs and remove from the heat. Pour the hot brine into a container large enough to hold the turkey and add the remaining 5 quarts of cold water to cool the brine. Place the turkey into the brine, making sure it is entirely submerged. Cover the container tightly with a lid or plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 12 hours or overnight. To roast the turkey: Preheat the oven to 350˚F. Remove the turkey from the brine and discard the brine, reserving the rosemary sprigs, and then pat the turkey skin dry with a clean towel. Stuff the main turkey cavity with half of the chopped celery, bell pepper, onion, and reserved brined rosemary sprigs, and tie the turkey legs together with butcher's twine. In a small heavy saucepan, melt 1/2 cup (1 stick) of the butter. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in 2 tablespoons of the spice mixture. Place the remaining celery, bell pepper, and onion in a large roasting pan with a rack. Set the roasting rack in the pan and place the turkey on the rack. Brush some of the spiced butter all over the turkey. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and roast the turkey for 1 hour and 40 minutes. Baste the turkey and continue roasting uncovered for about 1 hour and 20 minutes longer, or until a meat thermometer reads 160°F when inserted into the part of the thigh nearest to the thigh and hip joint. Transfer the turkey to a carving board (do not clean out the roasting pan), and rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before carving. To make the gravy: Set the roasting pan on the stove over medium-high heat. Add the chicken stock, thyme sprigs, and remaining rosemary sprig to the pan drippings in the roasting pan, and bring the mixture to a simmer, stirring often to scrape up the brown bits. Strain the pan juices, and discard all the solids. Spoon off the fat that has settled to the top of the pan juices. In a medium heavy saucepan, melt the remaining 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) of butter over medium heat. Stir in the remaining 2 teaspoons of the spice mixture (reserve any extra spice mixture

text: Cajun Smoked Turkey Cajun Smoked Turkey Ingredients: Delete All Turkey: 1 10-12 lb turkey Either stuffing OR Green Apples Onion Celery Brine: 1 1/2 Cups Salt 1 Cup Brown Sugar 1 Cup Molasses 1 Cup Honey 1/2 Cup Poultry Magic 4 Bay leaves Bunch of Thyme 1 Tbs Peppercorns 1 small Bag of Ice Rub: 1/2 Cup Kosher Salt 1/2 Cup Granulated Garlic 1 Tbs Poultry Seasoning Poultry Magic (second step) Injection: 1 Stick Butter 1 Cup Chicken Stock 1 Tbs Hot Sauce 1 tsp Granulated Garlic 1 tsp Cajun Seasoning Instructions: Delete All - Refrigerate turkey up to 3 days ahead to thaw. - 2 days ahead: Combine 1 Gal of water with remaining brine ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil. title: Cedar Planked Halibut with Charred Tomato Avocado Salsa
text: Cedar Planked Halibut with Charred Tomato Avocado Salsa Cedar Planked Halibut with Charred Tomato Avocado Salsa Ingredients: Delete All Halibut: 4 Halibut Steaks or Filets about 1 1/2 inches thick Marinade / Glaze: 4 TBS Honey 4 TBS Balsamic Vinegar 1/2 tsp Black Pepper 1/2 tsp Sea Salt Charred Tomato Avocado Salsa: 2 Large Beefsteak Tomatoes 1 Large Avocado Zest and Juice of 1 Small Lime Salt and Pepper to Taste 1/2 Small Red Onion, Finely Chopped 1 - 2 Cloves Minced Garlic 1/2 Finely Minced Jalapeno Pepper Instructions: Delete All For the Halibut: - Soak a cedar plank in water for 2 - 4 hours. - Wash the fish and pat it dry with paper towels. - Stir together the honey, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper and allow the fish to marinate for a min of 20 min, turning it occasionally. - Place the soaked cedar plank on a medium hot grill and close the lid until it begins to smoke. - Brush a little canola oil on top of the plank and place the marinated fish on it before closing the lid for about 20 min. - Adjust the heat to keep the internal temp about 375-400 degrees F. title: Chateaubriand
text: Chateaubriand Chateaubriand with Chateau Potatoes Ingredients: Delete All Chateaubriand: 1 center cut beef tenderloin (approx. 1lb.) 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons olive oil Salt / Ground black pepper 1 shallot, finely chopped 1/2 cup dry red wine 1/2 cup demi-glace 1 tablespoon butter, softened 1 tablespoon fresh Tarragon (2 teaspoons dried) Demi-Glace: 2 Cups Beef broth 1 Tbs Butter 1 tsp cornstarch in 3 Tbs Water 1/8 tsp balsamic vinegar Instructions: Delete All For the Chateaubriand: - If cooking for Medium & Medium Rare - Half the roast and put on 10 min before the other half. - Olive oil, Salt and Pepper the steak. - Baste the beef occasionally with the remaining demi-glace while cooking. - Sear the beef on high on all 4 sides for 5 min each side. - Remove to indirect heat and cook for 20 min. - While the steak is cooking prepare the sauce: In a hot skillet melt the butter and combine with the olive oil. - Add in the red wine, demi-glace, shallot, and tarragon. - Whisk together and heat until it becomes a light gravy. How to Grill Chateaubriand - Reverse Sear: - Start with a large, 1- to 2-pound beef tenderloin roast of at least 1 1/4-inch thickness. Brush both sides with oil and lightly season with salt and pepper. - If using a gas grill turn one side to the highest possible setting and the other to a medium low heat. Place the beef tenderloin on the low-temperature side and close the lid. - For medium rare leave the tenderloin to cook for 5 minutes. For medium and above, leave it for about 7 minutes before opening the lid and turning the meat, leaving it in the low-temperature zone. After an additional 5 to 7 minutes it is time to place it on the direct and high heat. - At this point, the tenderloin should be browned on both sides and through the edges with little or no grill marks. Leave the meat on the grill at a high temperature with the lid closed for two to three minutes depending on the heat of your grill, then check. Now there should be dark grill marks and a rich and dark brown color to the cooked side. If not, continued grilling until these are evident. Once you have this appearance, turn the meat over and continued on the other side. - Once finished on the grill, move the meat to a cutting board, cover and leave to rest for 5 to 10 minutes. Serving Chateaubriand: - See the recipe for traditional Chateaubriand. - To make the topping, melt 2 tablespoons of butter with 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy and hot skillet. Add one large, finely chopped shallot with 1/2 cup of white wine, 1/2 cup demi-glace, and 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon (2 teaspoons dried). Whisk together and heat until it thickens into a light gravy. - When the meat has rested, cut into thin strips against the grain and serve with the sauce. This dish is traditionally served with chateau potatoes. These small potatoes are roasted in a heavy pan, covered in butter. Not a recipe for the dieter, but well worth the extra calories. title: Cheesy Garlic Parmesan Spinach Orzo
text: Cheesy Garlic Parmesan Spinach Orzo Cheesy Garlic Parmesan Spinach Orzo Ingredients: Delete All 1 1/2 Cups orzo pasta 2 Tbs olive oil 2 1/2 tsp minced garlic Salt and pepper to taste 2 tsp flour 1 Cup milk 2/3 cup fresh spinach, roughly chopped 1/2 Cup shredded Parmesan cheese Optional: fresh lemon zest, grated parmesan, cracked black pepper for topping Half Recipe 3/4 Cup orzo pasta 1 Tbs olive oil 1 1/4 tsp minced garlic Salt and pepper to taste 1 tsp flour 1/2 Cup milk 1/3 cup fresh spinach, roughly chopped 1/4 Cup shredded Parmesan cheese Optional: fresh lemon zest, grated parmesan, cracked black pepper for topping Directions: Delete All - Cook orzo according to directions, drain and set aside. - Heat olive oil in a medium sized pot over medium heat. title: Chicken & Kale Ceasar Style Salad - Blue Apron
text: Chicken & Kale Ceasar Style Salad - Blue Apron Chicken & Kale Ceasar Style Salad - Blue Apron Ingredients Delete All Makes: 2 Servings Prep Time = 15 Min / Cook Time = 15 - 25 Min 2 Boneless, Skinless Chicken Thighs 3 Radishes 1 Bunch Kale 1 Clove Garlic 3 Tbs Mayonannaise 2 Tbs Flour 2 Tbs Roasted Almonds 2 Tbs Red Wine Vinegar 1/4 Cup Grated Pecorino Cheese Instructions Delete All Prepare The Ingredients Peel and mince the garlic - mash into a paste Remove the kale stems, roughly chop the leaves Halve the radishes lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise Roughly chop the Almonds Chop the chicken into bite size pieces and transfer into a medium bowl Make the Dressing and Massage the Kale In a bowl, combine the mayo, 2/3 of the vinegar, half of the cheese, and as much of the garlic paste as you want Drizzle with olive oil and stir to combine, season with salt and pepper In a large bowl, combine the Kale and 3/4 of the Dressing, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Using your hands, vigorously message the kale for 3 - 4 min. Marinate the Radishes In a bowl, combine the radishes and remaining vinegar. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat; season with salt and pepper to taste. Set aside to marinate, stirring occasionally, for at least 10 min. Coat and Cook the chicken: Season the chopped chicken with salt and pepper; toss to coat. Add the flour; toss to thoroughly coat. In a medium pan, heat a thin layer of oil on medium - high until hot. Add the coated chicken in a single layer. Cook, turning occasionally, 7 - 9 min. or until browned on all sides. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate and immediately salt and pepper. Finish the salad and Plate your dish To the bowl of kale, add cooked chicken, marinated radishes (drained), almonds and remaining dressing. Toss to combine and season with salt and pepper Plate and garnish with remaining cheese. Image - add later --> Image - add later -->

text: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup Chicken and Wild Rice Soup Ingredients Delete All 1 Cup Uncooked Quick-Cooking Wild Rice 1 Cup Chopped Onion 2 Garlic Cloves, Minced 3 Cups Chicken Broth 1 1/2 Cups Cubed Peeled Potato 3 Cups 2% (maybe fat free) Milk 1/3 Cup Flour 10 oz Light Processed Cheese, Cubed (such as Velveeta Light) ** Maybe Can Substitute Asiago?? ** 2 Cups Chopped Roasted Skinless Chicken Breasts ** OR Just Cut Up Buehlers Roasted or Smoked Chicken ?? ** 1/2 tsp Black Pepper 1/4 tsp Salt - ** May not need with real chicken broth ** 1/4 Cup Chopped Fresh Parsley Instructions Delete All Cook rice according to package instructions, omitting salt and fat Heat a large Dutch Oven over medium high heat, coat with cooking spray. text: Chicken Caesar Salad Chicken Caesar Salad Ingredients: Delete All Caesar Salad Dressing 3 slices country-style bread, cut into 1/2 in. cubes (optional) 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, or chicken tenders 1 large Romaine lettuce or 3 hearts of romaine, chopped 1 Cup freshly shaved Parmesian cheese Instructions: Delete All 1. title: Chicken Diane
text: Chicken Diane Chicken Diane Ingredients: Delete All 4 (5- to 6-ounce) boneless, skinless chicken breast cutlets, or 2 (10- to 12-ounce) chicken breasts, each halved horizontally into 2 cutlets 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt, divided 3/4 teaspoon black pepper, divided 1 tablespoon canola oil 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided 2 (8-ounce) packages sliced fresh button mushrooms 1 large (1 1/2 ounce) shallot, finely chopped (1/4 cup) 2 tablespoons (1 ounce) brandy 1/2 cup lower-sodium chicken broth 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice (from 1 lemon) 2 teaspoons Dijon mustard 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley Lemon wedges, for serving Instructions: Delete All - Sprinkle chicken evenly with 1 teaspoon of the salt and 1/2 teaspoon of the pepper. - Heat oil and 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet over high. Add chicken to skillet; cook until golden brown on each side and a thermometer inserted into thickest portion of meat registers 165°F, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a plate; set aside. Do not wipe skillet clean. - Reduce heat under skillet to medium-high. Add mushrooms and remaining 1 tablespoon butter; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms release liquid and begin to brown, about 5 minutes. - Add shallot; cook, stirring often, until tender, about 3 minutes. - Add brandy; cook, undisturbed, until liquid is almost evaporated, about 15 seconds. Add broth, cream, lemon juice, mustard, and Worcestershire; cook, stirring often, until sauce reduces slightly, about 3 minutes. - Stir in parsley and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Remove from heat. Nestle chicken and any accumulated juices into mixture in skillet. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Chicken Dijon
text: Chicken Dijon Chicken Dijon Ingredients: Delete All 1 teaspoon coriander seeds 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 8 medium chicken drumsticks (about 3 pounds) Salt and freshly ground pepper 1/4 cup finely chopped onion 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 2 tablespoons whole-grain mustard (optional: 1 Tbs Dijon mustard) 3 tablespoons crème fraîche or sour cream 2 teaspoons chopped tarragon or Marjoram Instructions: Delete All In a small bowl, whisk the mustard with the crème fraîche and tarragon. - In a large skillet, toast the coriander seeds over moderately high heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer the seeds to a mortar and let cool. Crush the seeds coarsely with a pestle. - In the same skillet, heat the olive oil until shimmering. Season the chicken drumsticks with salt and pepper, add them to the skillet and cook over moderately high heat, turning, until golden brown all over, about 10 minutes. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the broth and crushed coriander and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over moderately low heat until the chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. - Transfer the chicken to a platter, cover and keep warm. Whisk the mustard mixture into the skillet and simmer the sauce over moderate heat until thickened, about 5 minutes. Return the chicken to the skillet (do not include any liquid from the platter, it makes the sauce too thin) and turn to coat. Make Ahead: - The stew can be refrigerated for up to 3 days.

title: Chicken Marsala
text: Chicken Marsala Chicken Marsala by Chef John Ingredients: Delete All 2 Skin-on, Boneless Chicken Breasts (I used skinless last time) 1 tsp Salt and Ground Black Pepper to Taste 3 TBS Butter, Divided 2 TBS Olive Oil 5 White Mushrooms, Sliced 1 Shallot, Minced 1 TBS All-purpose Flour 1 Cup Marsala Wine 2 Cups Chicken Stock 2 TBS Chopped Fresh Parsley 1 tsp Cold Butter Instructions: Delete All - Season chicken breasts all over with salt and pepper. - Melt 1 1/2 TBS butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken breasts skin side down until browned, about 5 min. Flip and cook until breasts are almost cooked through, about 5 more min. Transfer to a plate. - Melt 1 1/2 TBS butter in same skillet over medium high heat. Saute mushrooms with a pinch of salt and a pinch of pepper until mushrooms are golden, 5 - 7 min. Add minced shallot; cook and stir until softened, 2 to 3 min. Sprinkle flour over the top and cook and stir until the bitterness of the flour cooks off, 3 to 4 min. - Pour wine into skillet and bring to a boil; cook and stir until wine reduces and sauce thickens, 3 to 4 min. Add chicken stock; bring to a simmer and cook until slightly reduced, 3 - 5 min. - Return chicken breasts to skillet, reduce heat to low, and cook chicken, turning once, until no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, about 10 min. Internal temp should read 165 degrees. - Move chicken to one side of the skillet and tilt the skillet so that the sauce pools at the bottom. Stir parsley and 1 tsp cold butter into the sauce, stirring constantly, until sauce is shiny and butter is completely melted. Transfer chicken to plates and spoon mushrooms and sauce over the top.

title: Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Spinach
text: Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Spinach Baked Chicken Ricotta Meatballs with Spinach Serve with pasta, crusty bread, salad, or roasted veggies for a complete meal. Ingredients: Delete All 1 lb ground chicken 1 cup Ricotta cheese 1 cup fresh spinach, finely chopped ½ cup bread crumbs or panko ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 egg 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tsp dried oregano 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Italian seasoning (to taste) ¼ cup fresh parsley, chopped 1 jar marinara sauce (about 24 oz) Olive oil for drizzling Directions: Delete All Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a large bowl, mix ground chicken, ricotta, spinach, breadcrumbs, parmesan, egg, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and parsley. Form mixture into 1.5" meatballs and place on parchment-lined baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and bake 20–25 minutes, until golden and cooked through. Broil for an additional 2–3 minutes for browning. Meanwhile, heat marinara sauce in a saucepan over medium heat. Serve meatballs warm with marinara, garnished with extra parsley and parmesan if desired. Notes: These meatballs pair wonderfully with pasta, crusty bread, or a fresh salad. Last time, I served them with Oven Roasted Zucchini and Squash for a light and flavorful side.

title: Chicken Stroganoff

title: Chopped Chicken Salad
text: Chopped Chicken Salad Chopped Chicken Salad Ingredients: Delete All 6 Boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 3 oz each) Marinade: 2 TBS Extra Virgin Olive Oil (EVOO) 2 TBS Freshly minced rosemary leaves 1 TBS Fresh lemon juice 1 TBS Minced garlic 1 1/2 tsp Kosher salt 1/4 tsp Ground black pepper Dressing: 1/2 cup Mayonnaise 3 TBS Dijon mustard 1/8 cup Honey 2 TBS Fresh lemon juice Kosher salt, to taste Ground black pepper, to taste Salad: 2 Hearts of romaine, chopped 1 cup Cherry tomatoes, quartered 2 Large avocados, diced 1/2 Small red onion, finely diced 4 Slices bacon, cooked and crumbled 3 Hard-boiled eggs, cut into wedges Directions: Delete All In a small bowl, whisk together all marinade ingredients. title: Chuck Roast Burnt Ends
text: Chuck Roast Burnt Ends Chuck Roast Burnt Ends Ingredients: Delete All 1 Chuck roast, approx. 3 lbs Brisket rub 1 Cup BBQ sauce (recommend Kansas City style) 1/2 Cup Beef broth Directions: Delete All Cut chuck roast into 1" x 1" cubes. Season with rub and arrange on a rack with space between each piece. Dry brine overnight in the refrigerator. Remove racks at least 2 hours before cooking to reach room temperature. Preheat smoker to 275°F and add fruity wood for smoke flavor. Place racks in the smoker and cook for 2 hours. Remove burnt ends from rack and arrange in a deep aluminum pan. Mix BBQ sauce and beef broth, then pour over burnt ends evenly. Cover pan with foil and return to smoker. Continue cooking for 2 hours or until burnt ends are tender. title: Cold Imitation Crab Dip
text: Cold Imitation Crab Dip Cold Imitation Crab Dip Serves 4–6 Ingredients Delete All 8 oz imitation crab meat, finely chopped ½ cup plain Greek yogurt (full-fat preferred) ¼ cup mayonnaise or 4 oz cream cheese, softened ¾–1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 2–3 tbsp pickle relish, drained well 1–2 tsp hot sauce (Frank’s, Crystal, or similar) ½ tsp garlic powder ¼ tsp onion powder Salt & black pepper, to taste Optional: 1–2 tbsp lemon juice or pickle juice for brightness Optional garnish: chopped green onions or dill Instructions Base: Mix yogurt with mayonnaise or cream cheese until smooth. Flavor: Stir in pickle relish, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and optional lemon/pickle juice. Crab: Fold in chopped imitation crab. Cheese: Gently mix in shredded mozzarella. Season: Taste and adjust salt, pepper, hot sauce, or relish. Chill: Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes (better after 1–2 hours). Serving Ideas Serve with crackers, pretzels, or pita chips Serve with celery sticks or cucumber rounds Spread on toast or bagels Use in tortilla pinwheels Variations Extra creamy: Use both mayo (2 tbsp) and cream cheese (2 oz) More bite: Add a pinch of cayenne or a splash of pickle juice Seafood-salad vibe: Mix in finely diced celery or green onion Lower fat: Use all yogurt and part-skim mozzarella

title: Crabmeat Avery
text: Crabmeat Avery Crabmeat Avery Makes 8 appetizer servings Ingredients: 2 1/2 TBS unsalted butter 1/3 cup finely chopped onions 1/3 cup finely chopped celery 1/3 cup finely chopped green bell peppers 1/4 cup finely chopped green onions 1/2 tsp minced garlic 6 TBS in all, Homemade Mayonnaise (in sides folder) 4 tsp creole mustard or brown mustard 2 tsp finely chopped fresh parsley 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp salt 1 tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp Tabasco 1/2 tsp white pepper 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 egg 1 lb lump crabmeat (picked over) 1/2 cup heavy cream Sweet paprika Instructions: Combine the butter, onions, celery, bell peppers, green onions and garlic in a 1 qt sauce pan; sauté over high heat until vegetables are tender but still firm, about 5 min, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Add 2 1/2 TBS of the mayo, the mustard, parsley, Worcestershire, salt, cayenne, Tabasco and the white and black pepper, stirring well. Beat in the egg with a metal whisk. Add the crabmeat to vegetable mixture and gently toss, leaving the lumps intact as much as possible. Spoon into 8 1/2-cup ovenproof ramekins. Pour 1 TBS cream over the top of each, then spread a thin, even layer of the remaining mayo on top and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350 degrees until brown and bubbly, about 15 - 18 min. Serve immediately.

title: Crawfish Enchiladas con Queso
text: Crawfish Enchiladas con Queso Crawfish Enchiladas con Queso Ingredients: Delete All 1/2 lb (2 sticks) unsalted butter, in all 1 cup finely chopped onions 1 cup canned green chilies, drained and chopped 3/4 cup finely chopped green bell peppers 2 3/4 tsp salt, in all 2 3/4 tsp white pepper 1 1/2 tsp ground red pepper (cayenne), in all 3/4 tsp dried oregano, in all 1/2 tsp minced garlic 3 cups heavy cream 1 cup sour cream 8 cups grated Monterey Jack cheese, 2 lbs, in all 2 lbs peeled crawfish tails 2/3 cup very finely chopped green onions 1/2 cup vegetable oil 20 (6") corn tortillas Instructions: Delete All - In a large skillet, melt 1 stick of the butter. Add the onions, green chilies, bell peppers, 1 1/4 tsp of salt, 3/4 tsp of white pepper, 1/2 tsp red pepper, 1/4 tsp oregano, and the garlic. Saute over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring often. - Stir in the heavy cream and bring mixture to a rapid boil; then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the sour cream; with a metal whisk, beat continuously until the sour cream is dissolved, about 3 minutes. Add 3 cups of the cheese and stir until melted. Set the sauce aside. - In a 4-quart saucepan, melt the remaining 1 stick butter. Add the crawfish, green onions, and the remaining 1 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp white pepper, 1 tsp red pepper, and 1/2 tsp oregano. Saute over medium heat for about 6 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cheese sauce to the crawfish mixture and stir well. Simmer until the flavors are well blended, about 6 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally; set aside. - In a small skillet, heat the oil to about 325 degrees. Holding tortillas one at a time with metal tongs, dip each into the hot oil just long enough to soften, about 1 second on each side; drain on paper towels. Spoon about 1/2 cup crawfish sauce on each tortilla and roll up tortilla. - For the prettiest presentation, broil the enchiladas: Put them all, seam side down, in a flameproof baking dish. Cover each enchilada from end to end with a generous amount of additional sauce, then sprinkle each with 1/4 cup of cheese. Place the baking dish under a broiler near the flame until the cheese melts and begins to turn brown, about 2 minutes. - Or, bake the enchiladas in a 350-degree oven until the cheese melts, about 5 to 8 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Cabbage Recipe
text: Creamy Cabbage Recipe Creamy Cabbage Ingredients: Delete All 6 cups shredded cabbage 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup water 1 package (3 oz.) cream cheese, cut into pieces 1/2 teaspoon celery seed Dash of pepper Directions: Delete All Cook cabbage in salted boiling water, covered, until tender. title: Creamy Feta Dressing
text: Creamy Feta Dressing Creamy Feta Dressing Ingredients: Delete All 1/2 Cup Mayonnaise or Plain Greek Yogurt (yogurt was better last time) 1/2 Cup Sour Cream or Creme Fraiche 6 Oz Feta Cheese, Crumbled 2 TBS Milk (skipped the milk last time, made it thicker) 1 Clove Garlic, Roughly Chopped 2 TBS Chopped Fresh Dill 1/4 tsp Dried Oregano 1/4 tsp Salt 1/4 tsp Ground Black Pepper Instructions: Delete All - Combine all ingredients in a food processor (or bowl for immersion blender). Process until well-blended and creamy. - Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Notes: - Make ahead: This dressing will keep nicely refrigerated for 4 days. title: Creamy Herb Chicken
text: Creamy Herb Chicken Creamy Herb Chicken Ingredients: Delete All For The Chicken: 4 Chicken Breasts Onion Powder and Garlic Powder to Season Herbes De Provence to Season 1 tsp Fresh Chopped Parsley Salt and Pepper For The Sauce: 4 Cloves of Garlic, minced 1 tsp Fresh Chopped Parsley 1/2 tsp Herbes De Provence 1 Cup Half and Half 1 tsp Corn Starch mixed with 1 TBS water, until smooth Salt and pepper to taste Instructions: Delete All - Coat the chicken with the onion and garlic powder, herbs, salt, and pepper. - Heat 1 TBS oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook until chicken is no longer pink, about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate and set aside. - To the same skillet, heat another 2 TBS of oil and saute garlic, parsley, herbes de provence for about 1 minute, or until fragrant. - Stir in milk, season with salt and pepper to taste. - Bring to a boil; add the cornstarch mixture to the center of the skillet, quickly stirring, until sauce has thickened slightly. - Reduce heat and simmer gently for a further minute to allow sauce to thicken more. - Return chicken to skillet, sprinkle with extra herbs if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Mushroom Wild Rice Skillet
text: Creamy Mushroom Wild Rice Skillet Creamy Mushroom Wild Rice Skillet Ingredients: Delete All 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil 1 Small Onion, Diced 2 Cloves Garlic, Minced 8 Ounces Mushrooms, Sliced 1 teaspoon Salt 1/2 teaspoon Pepper 1/2 teaspoon Italian Seasoning 2 Cups Chicken or Vegetable Broth 1 Cup Wild Rice** 1/4 Cup Heavy Cream 1/2 Cup Shredded Parmesan Cheese Directions: Delete All Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions and sliced mushrooms. Cook and stir occasionally until soft. Add minced garlic and stir for 1 minute. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Add broth and rice. Bring to a boil. title: Creamy Reuben Soup
text: Creamy Reuben Soup Creamy Reuben Soup Serves 6 Ingredients Delete All 2 tbsp butter 1 medium onion, diced 2 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp all-purpose flour 4 cups chicken broth 1½ cups half-and-half or whole milk 2 cups cooked corned beef, chopped 1½ cups sauerkraut, drained 1½ cups shredded Swiss cheese 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp caraway seeds (optional) Salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste Instructions In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Sprinkle in flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1–2 minutes. Gradually whisk in chicken broth until smooth. Stir in half-and-half and bring to a gentle simmer. Add corned beef, sauerkraut, Dijon mustard, and caraway seeds. Simmer 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low and stir in Swiss cheese until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Sundried Tomato + Parm Chicken Zoodles
text: Creamy Sundried Tomato + Parm Chicken Zoodles Creamy Sundried Tomato + Parm Chicken Zoodles Ingredients: Delete All 1 TBS Butter (w/ Olive Oil) 1 1/2 lb Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh Filets - cut into strips 7 oz jarred Sun Dried Tomatoes in oil - chopped 4 Cloves Garlic - peeled and smashed 1 1/4 Cup Heavy Cream (or Half and Half) 1 Cup Shaved Parmesan Cheese Salt to taste Dried Basil Red Chilli Flakes Zoodles or 2 Large Zucchini made into zoodles or sliced into "linguine" Instructions: Delete All - Heat the butter over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and sprinkle with salt. Pan fry until chicken is golden brown and cooked through. - Add the sun-dried tomatoes with 1 TBS of the oil from the jar, and the garlic. Saute until fragrant. (Add some red cooking wine at the end to deglaze the pan.) - Lower the heat, add the cream and Parmesan cheese, simmer while stirring until the cheese is melted. Sprinkle with salt, basil, and red chilli flakes. - Stir through the zoodles and continue to simmer until the zoodles have softened (about 5 - 8 minutes).

title: Creamy Tomato - Smoked Salmon Pasta
text: Creamy Tomato - Smoked Salmon Pasta Creamy Tomato - Smoked Salmon Pasta Ingredients Delete All 1 (8oz) package pasta (fresh) 1 TBS Butter 1 TBS EVOO 3 Shallots, minced 1 (28 oz) can peeled Italian Tomatoes, coarsely chopped, juices reserved 1 TBS Italian Herb Seasoning Salt to Taste White Pepper to Taste 1 1/2 Cups Heavy Whipping Cream 10 oz Smoked Salmon 1/2 Cup Dry White Wine 1/2 Cup Dry Cherry 1 TBS Chopped Basil 3 TBS grated Parmesan Cheese Instructions Delete All Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Season with Italian herbs, salt and white pepper. Cover and simmer 10 min. Remove pot from heat and puree until smooth. Stir in cream. Return pot to stove and bring to a boil. Add white wine, sherry and smoked salmon. Season with salt, white pepper and basil and heat until warmed through, but do not boil. Serve pasta with sauce and freshly grated Parmesan Cheese. title: Crème Brûlée
text: Crème Brûlée Crème Brûlée Ingredients 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup sugar 1 tbsp. vanilla extract 1 tsp. kosher salt 12 large egg yolks Instructions In a medium saucepan, combine the cream with 1⁄4 cup of the sugar, the vanilla, and salt, and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Stir until it just begins to bubble, then remove from heat. In a large bowl, whisk 1⁄4 cup of the sugar with the egg yolks until pale yellow, about 3 minutes. While whisking, slowly pour about 1⁄4 cup of the warm cream into the yolks, then scrape the yolk mixture into the saucepan and stir until smooth. Preheat the oven to 285°F. Place a paper towel in the bottom of a 9-by-13-inch baking pan, and arrange eight 6-oz. ramekins inside the pan. Divide the custard evenly among the ramekins. Pour enough boiling water into the pan to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake the custards until set but slightly loose in the center, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer the ramekins to a wire rack to cool completely, then refrigerate until firm, at least 4 hours. To serve, sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the remaining sugar evenly over each custard. Using a kitchen blowtorch, melt the sugar until it is bubbly and dark brown. Let the sugar harden for 1 minute before serving.

title: Creole Sauce
text: Creole Sauce Creole Sauce Makes about 2 ½ cups Ingredients Delete All Seasoning Mix 2 Whole bay leaves ¾ tsp Dried oregano leaves ½ tsp Salt ½ tsp White pepper ½ tsp Ground red pepper ½ tsp Sweet paprika ½ tsp Black pepper ½ tsp Dried thyme leaves ½ tsp Dried sweet basil leaves Main Ingredients 4 TBS Unsalted butter 1 Cup Peeled and chopped tomatoes ¾ Cup Chopped onions ¾ Cup Chopped celery ¾ Cup Chopped green bell peppers 1½ tsp Minced garlic 1¼ Cups Chicken stock 1 Cup Canned tomato sauce 1 tsp Sugar ½ tsp Tabasco sauce Instructions Delete All Combine all seasoning mix ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add tomatoes, onions, celery, and bell peppers to the skillet; stir to coat. Add minced garlic and seasoning mix, stirring thoroughly. Sauté until onions are transparent, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add chicken stock, tomato sauce, sugar, and Tabasco; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until vegetables are tender and flavors are married, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaves before serving. title: Crepes - Jacques Torres
text: Crepes - Jacques Torres Crepes - Jacques Torres Ingredients: Delete All 2 tbsp. unsalted butter 2 1⁄2 cups water 2 1⁄4 cups all-purpose flour 1⁄2 cup skim milk 2 large egg yolks 1 1⁄2 tsp. kosher salt 1 1⁄2 tsp. sugar Vegetable oil, for greasing Instructions: Delete All - In a small skillet, heat the butter over medium-high until it smells nutty and turns golden in color, about 4 minutes. - Pour the butter into a blender along with the water, flour, milk, egg yolks, salt, and sugar, and blend until smooth. Pour the batter into a bowl (you should have 4 cups). - Heat a 12-inch non-stick crêpe pan or skillet over medium-high heat and using a crumpled paper towel, grease the pan lightly with oil. - Using a ladle, pour ½ cup of the batter in the center of the pan, quickly swirling the pan to coat the entire surface with batter, and cook, without touching, for 2 minutes. - Using an offset spatula, carefully flip the crêpe and cook 1 minute more. Transfer the crêpe to a plate and repeat making crêpes with the remaining batter until you have 8 crêpes total.

title: Crispy Brown Butter Smashed Pickle Potatoes
text: Crispy Brown Butter Smashed Pickle Potatoes Crispy Brown Butter Smashed Pickle Potatoes Full Version & Weekday Dinner Version Full Version – 3 servings (2 dinners + 1 leftover lunch) Ingredients Delete All 1½ lbs red potatoes (18–22 small) 4 tbsp unsalted butter ¾ tsp kosher salt (+ extra for boiling) ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp garlic powder ½ cup freshly shredded sharp cheddar cheese ½ cup finely chopped dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 2 tbsp sour cream or Greek yogurt 1–2 tbsp fresh chopped dill (or 1 tsp dried) Optional: finely chopped red onion Optional: pinch crushed red pepper Optional: small squeeze of lemon for brown butter Instructions Boil potatoes in salted water 15–20 min until fork-tender. Drain and steam dry 5–10 min. Pat dry. Preheat oven 425°F, line sheet pan with parchment, preheat pan 5 min. Place potatoes on hot pan, smash to ~¼ inch, wait 30 sec, press gently again. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, garlic powder. Melt butter until foaming stops and solids turn golden. Remove from heat, stir in dill and optional lemon. Brush half the brown butter on potatoes, roast 20 min. Flip, brush remaining butter, roast 5–10 min until golden and crispy. Sprinkle cheddar, broil 1–2 min until bubbly and lightly browned. Mix sour cream, pickle juice, remaining dill. Spoon over potatoes, sprinkle pickles, optional onion or crushed red pepper. Leftover tip: reheat 400°F or in air fryer 8–10 min. Add fresh pickle topping after reheating. Weekday Dinner Version – 2 servings Ingredients 4 medium red potatoes 3 tbsp unsalted butter ½ tsp kosher salt (+ extra for boiling) ¼ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp garlic powder ⅓ cup freshly shredded sharp cheddar cheese ⅓ cup finely chopped dill pickles 2 tsp pickle juice 1½ tbsp sour cream or Greek yogurt 1 tbsp fresh chopped dill Optional: small squeeze of lemon for brown butter Instructions Same as full version, using smaller quantities. Roast times slightly shorter (~20–25 min). Broil cheese 1–2 min.

title: Crunchy Cracker-Coated Chicken Tenders
text: Crunchy Cracker-Coated Chicken Tenders Crunchy Cracker-Coated Chicken Tenders Great with dipping sauces like BBQ or Honey Dijon Dippping Suace Ingredients: Delete All 2 Large Egg Whites 1 TBS grated Parmesan Cheese 1 tsp dried Italian Seasoning 1/4 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper 1 Cup crushed reduced-fat baked whole-grain wheat crackers (Triscuits) 1 1/4 lb Chicken Tenders Cooking Spray Instructions: Delete All - Place a jelly-roll pan in oven, and pre-heat to 450 degrees. - Combine first 5 ingredients in a shallow dish; stir well. Place crushed crackers in another shallow dish or plate. - Dip chicken tenders in egg white mixture. Dredge chicken in crushed crackers, pressing firmly to coat; coat chicken tenders with cooking spray. - Place chicken on pan in a single layer. Bake at 450 for 25 min. or until chicken is done. title: Curried Beef Kababs
text: Curried Beef Kababs Curried Beef Kababs Ingredients: Delete All 4 Large Scallions 1 tsp Canola Oil 1/2 tsp Garlic 2 tsp Curry Powder 1 TBS Cayenne Pepper 1/8 tsp Salt 12 oz Beef Top Sirloin Instructions: Delete All - Preheat grill. - Combine oil, garlic, curry powder, and cayenne pepper in a large bowl; add beef and scallions. - Alternate beef and scallion pieces on four skewers. - Grill 8 - 10 minutes, turning occasionally, for medium, less for rare, more for well done. - Season to taste with salt and serve.

title: Dairy Queen Ice Cream Cake
text: Dairy Queen Ice Cream Cake Dairy Queen Ice Cream Cake Ingredients Chocolate Cookie Crunchies 3/4 Cup Oreo crumbs (about 9 Oreos) 1 1/2 TBS butter, melted Ice Cream Layers 1.5 quart container vanilla ice cream 1.5 quart container chocolate ice cream Chocolate Fudge 6 oz bag semi-sweet chocolate chips 3 TBS light corn syrup 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1/2 Cup heavy whipping cream Whipped Cream 2 Cups heavy whipping cream, cold 1 Cup powdered sugar 1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract Sprinkles (for decoration) Instructions Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat and set aside. Combine the Oreo crumbs and melted butter until well combined. Spread the crumbs evenly on the prepared cookie sheet. Bake for 8-10 minutes, then allow to cool. Break any large clumps into smaller pieces. Set aside. Line an 8×3 inch cake pan with plastic wrap, ensuring it covers the bottom and sides. Set aside. Soften the chocolate ice cream for about 20 minutes. Spread it evenly in the cake pan and freeze for 30 minutes. To make the fudge, combine chocolate chips, corn syrup, and vanilla extract in a bowl. Heat the cream until it just begins to boil, then pour it over the chocolate mixture. Whisk until smooth. Remove the cake pan from the freezer and pour the fudge over the chocolate ice cream. Freeze for 10 minutes. Add the cookie crumbles over the fudge layer and freeze for 2 hours. Soften the vanilla ice cream for about 20 minutes. Spread it over the cookie layer and freeze until firm (2-3 hours). Once frozen, remove the cake from the pan using the plastic wrap and place on a serving plate. Freeze again while preparing the whipped cream. To make whipped cream, whip together cold cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla until stiff peaks form. Frost the cake and decorate with sprinkles or desired toppings. Freeze until ready to serve. Best when stored covered and eaten within 4-5 days.

title: Daube Provence - Beef Stew
text: Daube Provence - Beef Stew Daube Provence - Beef Stew Ingredients: Delete All 3 Lb Boneless Chuck Roast 2 Garlic Cloves, crushed 1 Large White Onion, chopped 1 Shallot, chopped 3 Bay Leaves 1 Carrot, chopped 1 Small Fennel Bulb, chopped 3 in Strip of Dried Orange Peel 10 Black Peppercorns 2 Sprigs Thyme or Oregano 2 Sprigs Flat-Leaf Parsley 2 Cups Red Wine 2 TBS Olive Oil 3 oz Bacon or Diced Pancetta Salt and Freshly Ground Black Pepper Instructions: Delete All - To marinate the beef, cut the roast into 2 in chunks and place in a large bowl. Add the garlic, onion, shallot, bay leaves, carrot, fennel, orange peel, peppercorns, thyme, and parsley. Pour in the wine, stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight. - Remove the beef from the marinade and wipe well with paper towels. Strain the marinade through a sieve into a bowl. Reserve both the ingredients and the marinade. - Pour the oil into a large flameproof pan, add the bacon, and stir over medium heat for 2-3 min, until sizzling. Add the meat, increase the heat a little, and cook for 10 min, until brown on all sides. - Pour in the drained marinade ingredients. Cook and stir for 5 min, then pour in the marinade. Add a little boiling water - just enough to cover the ingredients - and bring to a boil. - Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 2 hours, stir and remove the parsley, thyme, and bay leaves. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Simmer, uncovered, for 15 min and serve hot. - ** If you prefer a deeper flavor: leave until cold, then remove and discard the surface fat, and reheat, covered, over low heat **

text: Dijon Fish Cakes with Greens Dijon Fish Cakes with Greens Ingredients: Delete All 4 - 6 oz Tilapia Filets - or 1.5 lbs Cod 1/2 Cup Mayonnaise 2 Large Eggs 2 TBS Chopped Fresh Dill 1 TBS Dijon Mustard 1 tsp Dijon Mustard 3/4 Cup Panko 2 TBS Canola Oil 2 TBS Olive Oil 1 1/2 TBS Red Wine Vinegar 5 oz Salad Greens Kosher Salt and Black Pepper HALF RECIPE 2 - 3 oz Tilapia Filets - or 3/4 lbs Cod 1/4 Cup Mayonnaise 1 Large Eggs 1 TBS Chopped Fresh Dill 1/2 TBS Dijon Mustard 1 tsp Dijon Mustard 1/3 Cup (STRONG) Panko 2 TBS Canola Oil 2 TBS Olive Oil 1 1/2 TBS Red Wine Vinegar 5 oz Salad Greens Kosher Salt and Black Pepper Instructions: Delete All - Heat oven to 400 degrees F. Place the tilapia on a rimmed baking sheet and season with salt and pepper. Bake until cooked through, about 10 - 12 min. Let cool and flake into small pieces. - In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, eggs, dill, and 1 TBS of mustard. Fold in the tilapia and panko. Form the mixture into 8 cakes and chill for at least 30 min. (or overnight if doing ahead) - Heat the canola oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook the cakes until golden, 3 - 5 min per side. - Meanwhile, in a large bowl whisk together the olive oil, vinegar, 1 tsp of mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Add the salad greens and toss to combine. Serve with the fish cakes.

title: Dijon Vinaigrette

Slowly whisk in the olive oil to make an emulsion. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Double Smoked - Cajun Glazed Ham
text: Double Smoked - Cajun Glazed Ham Double Smoked - Cajun Glazed Ham Ingredients: 8 - 12 lb pre-cooked, smoked spiral cut ham 2 Cups Apple Wood Chips 2 Cups Apple Juice, divided Glaze: 1 Cup brown sugar 4 Jalapeños, seeded and diced 2 Garlic cloves, minced 2 TBS white wine vinegar 2 TBS spicy brown mustard 1 TBS paprika 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper 1/2 tsp dried thyme 1/2 tsp dried oregano Instructions: - Overnight: Bring ham to room temp, trim excess fat, rinse, and pat dry. - 1-2 hours before smoking: Soak wood chips in water. - Preheat smoker to 300°F. - Place ham in a foil container, pour half the apple juice over the ham, and smoke uncovered at 220-250°F for 1 hour, spritzing with apple juice every 15 minutes. - Preheat grill to 400°F for indirect heat (outside burners on medium-high, inside burners on low). - Lower outside burners to medium, turn off inside burners, cover ham with foil, and bake at 300-330°F for 1 1/2 hours. - Move ham to a Dutch oven, uncover, and baste with the glaze every 10 minutes for 30 minutes. - If traveling: cover, transport, and serve with remaining glaze. - Uncover ham and baste with glaze every 10 minutes for 20-30 minutes. Let rest for 10-15 minutes before carving. - Serve with remaining glaze.

title: Double Streusel Apple Butter Bars
text: Double Streusel Apple Butter Bars Double Streusel Apple Butter Bars Sweet, spiced, and crumbly Ingredients Delete All 2 cups all-purpose flour 1½ cups old-fashioned oats ½ cup raw pecans 1 cup brown sugar 1 tsp baking powder 1 tsp cinnamon ¼ tsp nutmeg 2 tsp vanilla extract 2 tbsp cold salted butter, thinly sliced Apple butter (for filling) Apples, sliced (for filling) Instructions Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9" × 13" baking dish with parchment paper. In a food processor, pulse flour, oats, pecans, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and nutmeg until oats are mostly ground. Add cold butter and pulse until a crumbly dough forms. If dry, add 1 tbsp water. Press ⅓ of the dough into the prepared baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes or until lightly golden. Spread apple butter evenly over the baked crust. Arrange apples evenly over the apple butter. Sprinkle remaining ⅔ of streusel dough over the apples. Lay butter slices over the streusel. Bake 30–40 minutes until topping is lightly golden. Cool completely before cutting into bars.

title: Easy Chicken and Rice Soup
text: Easy Chicken and Rice Soup Easy Chicken and Rice Soup Ingredients Delete All 1 TBS EVOO 1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped 2 Garlic Cloves, minced 2 Medium Carrots, chopped 2 Celery Ribs, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices 4 Fresh Thyme Sprigs 1 Bay Leaf 2 Quarts Chicken Stock 1 Cup Water 1 Cup Long Grain White Rice, uncooked (last time I used pre cooked simmered cooked rice) 2 Cups Shredded Chicken (last time I used rotisserie chicken) Kosher Salt and Ground Black Pepper Instructions Delete All Place a large pot over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the onion, garlic, carrots, celery, thyme, and bay leaf. Cook and stir for about 6 min., until the vegetables are softened but not browned. Pour in the chicken broth and water and bring the liquid to a boil. Add in the rice and chicken; season with salt and pepper. Cook on medium-low until the rice is tender, about 25 - 30 min. Serve warm. NOTES: To cook the chicken, bring a pot of water to boil and add 2 chicken breasts, that have been cut into large pieces. Boil the chicken until its is cooked all the way through and there is no pink left, about 7 min. Wait until cooled and shred. Image - add later --> Image - add later -->

title: Easy Honey Garlic Slow Cooker Ribs
text: Easy Honey Garlic Slow Cooker Ribs Easy Honey Garlic Slow Cooker Ribs Ingredients: Delete All 1 (2 1/2 - 3 lb) rack of pork ribs, halved 1 TBS salt 1 TBS pepper 1 TBS paprika 1 TBS chili powder 1 Cup honey 1/2 Cup soy sauce 10 cloves garlic, minced Directions: Delete All - Season ribs evenly with salt, pepper, paprika, and chili powder. Rub in on all sides. - Add honey, soy sauce, and garlic to a large slow cooker. - Transfer the ribs to slow cooker and turn them over in sauce until coated. Position the ribs so they are standing up, with the meatier side down, and so the meat side is against the walls of the slow cooker, with the bone sides facing in. - Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, or low for 7 - 8 hours. (Ours was on low for 5 hours) - *** Try the rub we have in the pantry in place of the rub listed above ***

title: Easy Marry Me Chicken Soup
text: Easy Marry Me Chicken Soup Easy Marry Me Chicken Soup Serves 8 • Cozy, Creamy Comfort Soup Ingredients Delete All 4 chicken breasts (or shredded rotisserie chicken – see note below) 2 tbsp olive oil 3 tbsp all-purpose seasoning 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato oil 1/2 yellow onion, diced 4 garlic cloves, chopped 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped 2 tbsp tomato paste 6 cups unsalted chicken broth 2 cups pasta shells 5 oz baby spinach 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 tbsp Italian seasoning 1/2 tbsp crushed red pepper flakes Salt & pepper, to taste Instructions Season chicken breasts with all-purpose seasoning. Heat a Dutch oven or large pot with olive oil over medium heat. Cook chicken until internal temperature reaches 160°F; remove and set aside. Add sun-dried tomato oil and diced onion; sauté until translucent. Add chopped sun-dried tomatoes and garlic; sauté 1–2 minutes. Stir in tomato paste until well combined. Pour in chicken broth, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes; bring to a boil. Add pasta shells and cook until al dente. Shred or chop chicken and wash spinach. Add cream, Parmesan, chicken, and spinach; stir well. Cook 10 more minutes until spinach is wilted and soup thickens. Adjust seasoning and serve with extra Parmesan and parsley. Chef’s Note You can substitute a store-bought rotisserie chicken for the chicken breasts. Simply shred the meat and add it when the recipe calls for adding the cooked chicken. This is a great shortcut for busy weeknights.

title: Eggs Baked with Smoked Salmon
text: Eggs Baked with Smoked Salmon Eggs Baked with Smoked Salmon A sophisticated and delicious breakfast or brunch recipe for seafood lovers. Ingredients: Clear All 1 1⁄2 tbsp. unsalted butter, melted 6 oz. thinly sliced smoked salmon 3⁄4 cup heavy cream 4 eggs Kosher salt, to taste Freshly ground white pepper, to taste 2 tbsp. freshly grated horseradish or prepared horseradish, drained 2 chives, cut into 1″ pieces Instructions: Clear All 1. Heat oven to 375°F. Grease four 6-oz. ramekins with melted butter and place them in a 9" x 13" baking dish lined with parchment paper. 2. Arrange the salmon along the bottom and sides of the ramekins, reserving 1 slice for garnish. 3. Pour 1 tbsp. cream into each ramekin and crack an egg on top; season with salt and pepper. 4. Place the baking dish in the oven and pour boiling water halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 15–17 minutes, until the egg whites are set but yolks remain soft. 5. Whip the remaining cream until soft peaks form, then fold in horseradish and season with salt and pepper. 6. Julienne the reserved slice of salmon and garnish the baked eggs with the salmon, horseradish cream, and chives before serving.

title: Eggs Jeannette
text: Eggs Jeannette Eggs Jeannette A classic French dish that's perfect for brunch or a light meal. Ingredients: Clear All 4 Half Boiled Eggs 2 TBS Parsley 1 Large Garlic Clove 1 Anchovy Filet 2 TBS Milk 1 TBS Water 2 tsp Dijon Mustard Dash of Red Wine Vinegar Olive Oil Instructions: Clear All 1. Peel, cut, and remove yolks from half-boiled eggs. 2. Add parsley, garlic, and anchovy filet to yolks and mash together. 3. Add salt, pepper, and milk to create a puree. 4. Stuff the eggs with the mixture, reserving some for the sauce. 5. Saute eggs, stuffed side down, in olive oil for 3-4 minutes. 6. For the sauce, add mustard, red wine vinegar, anchovy oil, and water to the reserved mixture and emulsify with olive oil. 7. Pour the sauce onto a gratin plate and place the eggs in the sauce.

title: Farro w/ Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato
text: Farro w/ Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato Farro w/ Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato Ingredients Delete All For the roasted vegetables: 1 large (about 1 lb) Sweet Potato 1 lb. Brussels Sprouts, cleaned and sliced in half 4 Tbsp Extra Virgin Olive Oil 1 Teaspoon Salt or (2 teaspoons Kosher Salt) 1/2 teaspoon black Pepper For the farro: 1 1/4 cup Farro (any type – I used "semi-pearled"), rinsed 1/2 teaspoon salt or 1 teaspoon Kosher Salt For the farro I bought, it called for 2.5 cups of water, next time use a wider pan. For the balsamic maple dressing: 4 Tablespoons Balsamic Vinegar 2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup 1 Tablespoon Tomato Paste 1 teaspoon Dijon Mustard 1/4 teaspoon salt (or 1/2 teaspoon Kosher Salt) 1/4 teaspoon pepper Garnish: Fresh Basil leaves, sliced or chopped Fresh Sage leaves, sliced or chopped Instructions Delete All Preheat oven to 400F. Spray or parchment-line an 11×18 sheet pan. Peel Sweet Potato if desired, then chop into 3/4″ (bite-sized) cubes. Place in bowl with sliced brussels sprouts. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper and stir together to distribute seasonings. Pour over sheet pan in a single layer. Roast in preheated oven for 35-40 minutes until roasty and tender. Stir after 20 minutes. While veggies are roasting, boil about 6 cups of water in a Medium (3-quart) saucepan, along with the salt. When boiling, add the farro, and cook until tender or according to package directions. There are several types of farro for which cook times vary. When done it should be tender, but still chewy. Drain when done cooking, pour into serving bowl, and fluff with a fork. Make the dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together all of the dressing ingredients. Mix the roasted vegetables into the farro and top with about 2/3 of the dressing, saving the rest top drizzle at the table, if desired. Top salad with the sliced or chopped herbs – I like mine with lots of fresh herbs – about a handful of each – these two herbs together are delicious! Serve warm or cold, if preferred. title: Feta Skharas
text: Feta Skharas Feta Skharas Ingredients Delete All Feta Cheese: 12 oz 1 Tomato - Chopped 1 Sweet Pepper 1 tsp Greek Oregano (Greek Seasoning) Instructions Delete All Place feta slices on a piece of foil large enough to wrap around the slices without overcrowding them. Top the cheese with the chopped tomatoes, pepper slices, Greek seasoning, and a couple of drops of olive oil. Wrap the feta slices securely in the foil. Heat the grill or oven to 375 degrees and cook for 15 - 17 min. Each slice should be soft in the center when you press your finger in it. Transfer to a bowl or plate and serve. Notes For best results, bring the feta to room temp before grilling / baking The pepper can be mild or hot, depending on your taste Thyme is an acceptable substitute for oregano Can also be roasted in the oven at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 min. title: Firecracker Salmon
text: Firecracker Salmon Firecracker Salmon Ingredients For 2: Delete All 0.5 teaspoon minced garlic 0.25 teaspoon minced ginger 0.5 tablespoon olive oil 0.5 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce 1 tablespoon Heinz chili sauce (or substitute) 0.5 teaspoon brown sugar (optional) pinch of crushed red chili flakes 0.5-1 teaspoons sriracha 2 skin off salmon fillets Salt and pepper to season 0.25 teaspoon paprika 0.13 cup chives chopped Ingredients For 4: 1 teaspoon minced garlic 1/2 teaspoon minced ginger 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce 2 tablespoons Heinz chili sauce (or substitute) 1 teaspoon brown sugar (optional) pinch of crushed red chili flakes 1-2 teaspoons sriracha 4 skin off salmon fillets Salt and pepper to season 1/2 teaspoon paprika 1/4 cup chives chopped Instructions: Delete All - In a shallow bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, minced ginger, olive oil, soy sauce, chili sauce, brown sugar, red chili flakes, and sriracha to combine. - Season salmon with salt, pepper, and paprika. Add salmon fillets to the marinade, turning each to evenly coat in the sauce. - Cover with plastic wrap and let marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight (if time allows). - Preheat oven to 370°F (190°C). Heat an oven-proof skillet over medium heat with a small drizzle of oil. - Sear salmon for 2-3 minutes on both sides, undisturbed, to get a nice crust. (You may need to sear in batches depending on the size of your skillet.) Transfer to plate and repeat with remaining salmon. - Return all salmon fillets to the skillet. Alternatively, transfer to baking dish. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Serve warm with chopped chives. - FOR ADDED FLAVOUR: Make a double batch of firecracker sauce. Brush the salmon after baking with the extra sauce before serving. title: Fish Amandine
text: Fish Amandine Fish Amandine Ingredients: Delete All 4 4-oz fresh or frozen skinless tilapia, trout, or halibut fillets 1/4 Cup buttermilk 1/2 Cup panko bread crumbs or fine dry bread crumbs 2 Tbs fresh parsley 1/2 tsp dry mustard 1/4 tsp salt 1/4 cup sliced almonds, coarsely chopped 2 Tbs grated Parmesan Cheese 1 Tbs butter 1/8 tsp crushed red pepper 1 lemon, cut into wedges to put on plates Directions: Delete All - Preheat oven to 450°F. Grease a shallow baking pan; set aside. Rinse fish; pat dry with paper towels. - Pour buttermilk into a shallow dish. In another shallow dish combine bread crumbs, parsley, dry mustard, and salt. Dip fish into buttermilk, then into crumb mixture, turning to coat. Place coated fish in the prepared baking pan. - Sprinkle fish with almonds and Parmesan; drizzle with melted butter. Sprinkle with crushed red pepper. Bake 4 to 6 minutes per 1/2" thickness of fish or until fish flakes easily when tested. title: French Grated Carrot Salad
text: French Grated Carrot Salad French Grated Carrot Salad Ingredients: 1 lb carrots, peeled 2 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tbsp freshly squeezed lemon juice 1 1/2 tbsp vegetable oil 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil 1-2 tsp honey 1/4 heaping tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 2 scallions, thinly sliced Instructions: Grate the carrots and set aside. In a salad bowl, combine Dijon mustard, lemon juice, honey, vegetable oil, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Add grated carrots, fresh parsley, and scallions to the bowl and toss well. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Check seasoning before serving as flavors may mellow.

title: French Onion Soup - Light
text: French Onion Soup - Light French Onion Soup - Light Ingredients Delete All ** We agreed to double this recipe so we can freeze half and still have leftovers ** DOUBLE RECIPE (with Jan 2020 adjustments) 2 TBS EVOO 4 Large Onions, Halved and Thinly Sliced 1 Clove Garlic Kosher Salt Lg Bundle Bouquet Garni (Fresh Thyme and Fresh Bay Leaves) 1/2 Cup (strong) Dry White Wine 1/2 Cup (strong) Bourbon (Jim Beam) 2 TBS Soy Sauce 12 Cups Beef Broth 8 1/2-Inch Thick Slices Baguette 1/2 Cup Freshly Grated Gruyère Cheese SINGLE RECIPE 1 TBS EVOO 2 Large Onions, Halved and Thinly Sliced Kosher salt 1/4 Cup Dry White Wine 1 TBS Soy Sauce 6 Cups Beef Broth Four 1/2-inch-thick slices of whole-grain baguette 1/4 cup freshly grated Gruyère cheese Instructions Delete All Instructions (with Jan 2020 adjustments) Step 1 In a large enameled cast-iron casserole, heat the oil until shimmering. Add the onions and garlic and cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until the onions are wilted and just starting to brown, about 7 minutes. Add a generous pinch of salt and cook over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally, until the onions are soft and golden, 25 to 30 minutes. Step 2 Add the wine, bourbon ( cognac ) and soy sauce and cook over moderate heat, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom, until evaporated, about 3 minutes. Add the stock and bouquet garni and bring to a boil. Simmer over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally, until the broth is well flavored and slightly reduced, about 10 minutes. Season the soup with salt. SKIP It's salty enough Step 3 Meanwhile, preheat the broiler. Arrange the bread on a baking sheet and top each piece with 1 tablespoon of the cheese. Broil 6 inches from the heat until the cheese is melted and just starting to brown, about 2 minutes. To serve, ladle the soup into bowls and top with the toast. Make Ahead The recipe can be prepared through Step 2 and refrigerated for up to 2 days. Reheat gently. Notes One Serving: 145 cal, 6 gm fat, 1.6 gm sat fat, 14 gm carb, 2 gm fiber, 8 gm protein.
